text:
ella: FYI opened a PR to clarify audit log examples: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/544 — goal: align SDK snippets with SOC2 wording for tenant identifiers and retention.
omar: can you paste the current example here?
ella: current doc shows: 
```json
{"tenant_id": "org_77", "user": "samu@example.com", "event": "deploy"}
```
rex: for SOC2 we should stop using plain tenant_id in examples. Recommend using `tenant_hash` and call out pseudonymization + salted hashing.
lucy-legal: Legal preference: phrase should be "tenant identifiers are pseudonymized using a salted hash (e.g., SHA-256 with secret salt). Mapping tables, if any, are access-restricted and access to them is logged and audited." Also request a sentence about retention defaults and export encryption.
ella: proposed doc paragraph: "Audit logs record tenant identifiers as salted hashes (tenant_hash). Mapping tables are access-restricted and access is audited. Audit exports are encrypted at rest. Default retention is 90 days; customers may configure export.retention_days." Thoughts?
omar: looks good. Suggest swapping 'salted hashes' -> 'salted, irreversible hashes' if we want to emphasize non-reversible. But only say that if we actually won't keep mapping tables.
rex: add a tiny migration note in the SDK section showing how to compute tenant_hash and a short python snippet. Keep code comment: do not log raw tenant IDs.
build-bot: Preview site build for PR 544: https://deploy.previews.redwood/544 — build passed.
ella: snippet I added: 
```python
import hashlib
raw = b"tenant:acme"
secret_salt = get_secret_from_kms()  # store salt in KMS
tenant_hash = hashlib.sha256(secret_salt + raw).hexdigest()
client.audit.log_event(tenant_hash=tenant_hash, actor=None, event="deploy")
# do not include raw tenant_id in logs or exports
```
lucy-legal: Please add 'audited access' wording and mention KMS for salt storage. Also request a one-line FAQ entry: "Why the change?" -> privacy + reduce PII surface in logs.
omar: added FAQ and a short note about rotating salts on key rotation. Also fixed two broken anchors in the API reference (audit-exports).
ella: CI green. @lucy-legal can you sign off?
lucy-legal: LGTM with small tweak: replace 'get_secret_from_kms()' comment with explicit 'retrieve salt from KMS/HSM' in the snippet commentary.
elia: updated snippet per legal, pushed commit.
build-bot: Link checker found no remaining broken anchors.
omar: once legal approves i'll merge.
lucy-legal: Approved. Keep conservative phrasing.
elia: merging now. :shipit: Thanks team.
rex: follow-up: add enterprise migration note about customers who store mappings on-prem.
elia: will add in a follow-up PR. Closing thread.
omar: thanks everyone.
